title: Split planning_round in planning.rs under the 200-line limit
summary: Break the 291-line planning_round (crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs, line 80) into smaller private helper methods so every function is at most 200 lines. Behavior stays identical. The audience is code health and the reviewer.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check function length and passing tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs; planning_round spans lines 80-387, followed by end_round (388), findings_line, redacted, plan_record, planning_grant, and a tests module at line 596.
Goal: reduce the function length below 200 lines by extracting helpers within the same file; no module split is needed since the file is 515 production lines, well under 2000.
Helpers stay private; no public API, record format or prompt changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: In crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs, planning_round is at most 200 lines and no other function exceeds 200 lines (check by reading the file).
Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: all existing tests, including those in planning.rs, pass unchanged.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
The diff touches only crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs, contains no change to existing test code, and the extracted code moves without changed logic.
